learning_outcomes.text: Students will have basic and introductory knowledge about various civilizations.
Students will understand the concepts of civilization and culture.
Students will understand the artistic and aesthetic features of different civilizations.
Students will learn to prepare assignments at an academic level.
Students will learn the notions of change and transformation.

syllabus_topics: Important Developments and Events in the History of Civilization
